enemy-037-neomorph.designLock: Alien Covenant (2017) adult Neomorph, based on the licensed NECA51659 photographic sculpture references, visually inspected. Pale ivory/cool-gray organic skin, not black biomechanical chitin; very lean biped with visible ribcage, narrow abdomen and pelvis, elongated forearms and large clawed hands. Smooth eyeless bulbous anterior skull extending rearward into a narrow swept point, recessed toothy facial opening, no visible human or animal eyes. Long thin solid dorsal spines, with prominent upper rods and smaller lower vertebral projections; no tubular Xenomorph exhausts or Queen crest. Exactly two arms and two long lean legs; slender articulated feet, no hooves. Long supple thin skin-covered segmented tail tapered to a small point, not a broad spear blade. Preserve its adult proportions in strict right-facing side view. Use grounded hunched biped locomotion and forearm/claw strike; no separate Xenomorph inner-jaw piston, no juvenile in the same sheet, no toy joints, no clothing, no armor, no pink/magenta material or reflected chroma light. The photographs are licensed sculpture references, not evidence of pixel-exact film reconstruction.
